records.source_title: Forestry industry still feeling effects of Black Summer looks at how to best protect plantations
records.mechanism: Fire burned about a third of the region's softwood plantations, cutting log supply to local mills in a region where forestry is more than half of jobs -> IL
records.quant_evidence: 50,000 of 168,000 ha softwood plantation burnt; 42% of burnt wood salvaged; softwood industry employs 11,000+ in the region

records.source_title: Bushfires in southern New South Wales spark race against time to save billion-dollar timber industry
records.mechanism: Burnt pine must be harvested within 12-18 months before it spoils, so mills face a salvage glut then a long supply gap; jobs depend on that supply -> IL
records.quant_evidence: About 48,000-50,000 ha of pine burnt; A$2bn industry employing about 5,000 directly and indirectly; 12-18 months to salvage
